methodology: Owner-governed pricing inputs using public learning-platform models, specialist professional training observations, instructional hours, assessment rigor, target audience, and Obserra course demand. Recommendations never publish automatically.

Foundation.positioning: Accessible entry-level professional development with interactive lessons and completion assessment.

Professional.positioning: Role-specific professional training with applied scenarios, knowledge checks, and practical outcomes.

Advanced.positioning: Deep technical or governance training with advanced scenarios, evidence-based application, and rigorous assessment.

Executive Intensive.positioning: Executive-focused programs emphasizing strategic decisions, organizational consequences, governance, and action planning.

CISO Masterclass.positioning: Premium executive masterclasses built around leadership judgment, enterprise strategy, board communication, and applied decision work.

academySubscription.notes: Use only after sufficient catalog depth and learner demand are established.

teamLicense.notes: Price by learner band, reporting, assignment workflows, and enterprise support.

enterpriseAcademy.notes: Includes team administration, reporting, curated pathways, custom content, and EIOS integration where contracted.

increasePriceWhen: Conversion remains stable above target after sufficient traffic
Completion and assessment pass rates demonstrate strong learner value
Course demand exceeds comparable Academy offerings
The course includes premium executive, technical, or regulatory specialization
Enterprise buyers request team licensing or reporting
decreaseOrPackageWhen: High page traffic produces weak checkout conversion
Repeated price objections appear in Obserrian complaint trends
A course is primarily an entry product for a larger pathway
Completion rates indicate a need for redesign before premium pricing
A bundle improves lifetime value without eroding premium positioning

guardrails.certificateClaimMustRemain: Certificate of course completion only; not a government license, academic credit, or third-party professional certification.

marketObservations.observation: Uses subscriptions and individual learning products, with broad access to courses and professional certificates.
Uses subscription access and includes completion certificates, quizzes, exercise files, history, and recommendations.
Advanced cybersecurity, governance, and executive programs command higher one-time prices when assessment rigor, specialization, and practical application are clear.
